input: Map out a zero-waste grocery shopping routine

gold.taskTitle: Build a Zero-Waste Grocery Shopping Routine
gold.taskDescription: Map out a repeatable, zero-waste grocery shopping routine that minimises packaging and waste at every step.

questions.title: Which stores or markets do you currently shop at?
questions.description: Identify the specific grocery stores, farmers markets, or bulk food shops the user has access to or already uses.

questions.title: What is your biggest source of packaging waste right now?
questions.description: Pinpoint whether the main waste comes from produce bags, plastic-wrapped items, beverages, toiletries, or another category.

questions.title: How often do you shop for groceries each week?
questions.description: Understand the frequency and rhythm of shopping trips to design a realistic routine around them.

questions.title: Do you already own any zero-waste tools or containers?
questions.description: Find out if the user has reusable bags, glass jars, beeswax wraps, or other tools already on hand.

questions.title: Are you cooking for yourself or a household of multiple people?
questions.description: Clarify the household size so quantities, container needs, and meal planning scale appropriately.

questions.title: Is there a budget limit for zero-waste supplies or food?
questions.description: Understand any financial constraints that would affect recommendations for bulk buying, specialty stores, or new containers.

questions.title: Which part of the routine feels hardest to change right now?
questions.description: Identify the user's biggest perceived barrier, such as meal planning, finding bulk stores, or resisting convenience packaging.
